summary.text: The full text of WHO's Global hepatitis report 2026, opening with copyright information, contents and forewords by the Director-General and the HIV, TB, hepatitis and STI department director. The forewords note progress such as high hepatitis B vaccine coverage and hepatitis C cure rates above 95%, but say progress is too slow and uneven to meet the 2030 elimination targets. Chapters cover global commitments and targets, epidemic status and trends, prevention, diagnosis and treatment, and the road to elimination, with annexes on methods, reporting and World Health Assembly resolutions. The text ends with lists of recommended country actions and requests to WHO, such as technical support, guidelines, monitoring, blood safety guidance and support for TRIPS flexibilities.
